decision.observation: Thursday the 11th, 11:20 p.m.; the farmer has reached the sandy beach, with a large dark building visible along the right edge.
decision.hypothesis: Moving east toward that building should reveal whether it is the Fish Shop and whether Willy is still available late at night.
decision.memory: Beach reached: from town's southern cobblestone road, go east, follow the dirt path south, and cross the river bridge. The Fish Shop and Willy's promised item remain the target; funds are 218g.
